title: docs(spec): seven more liveness ledgers cite the deciding commit, or state the decision in words, in place of dead tracker numbers
body:
Part of #20234

Clause-②: no

Slice 2 covers the `datasource`, `api`, `query`, `object`, `email_template`, `mapping` and `webhook` ledgers. Each note that cited a tracker number answering 404 now names the commit that decided it, or, where the number alone carried the meaning, says what was decided. The `manifest` `permissions` note gains the commit pointer the slice-1 review asked for. Only `note` and `_note` strings change: no status, evidence, proof or date moves. One `datasource` evidence string still cites `#8874`; the next slice takes it. One `@objectstack/spec` patch changeset.
